lines.en: I walk over, dragging my long tail

lines.zh: 我的蹄子踩在石头上响
lines.en: My hooves ring on the stone
My wings stay half unfurled
I walk step by step toward the firelight

lines.zh: 我从岩壁的阴影里穿过去
lines.en: I pass through the cliff's shadow
My horns could shove stone aside
I walk through the Nether's red haze

lines.zh: 我停下来，翅膀扇了一下
lines.en: I stop and beat my wings once
I head toward whatever lives

lines.zh: 我的尾巴扫过地面，留下一道痕
lines.en: My tail draws a line across the ground
I'm faster than I look
I fly a stretch and land again

lines.zh: 我站着，翅膀在身后开合
lines.en: I stand with my wings opening behind me

lines.zh: 我的手指敲了敲自己的手臂
lines.en: My fingers tap my own arm

lines.zh: 我在手里凝出一把镰刀
lines.en: I shape a sickle in my hand

lines.zh: 火光把我的影子拉得很长
lines.en: Firelight stretches my shadow long

lines.zh: 我低头看着自己的蹄子
lines.en: I look down at my hooves
I smell sulfur and blood
There's an old crack in one horn

lines.zh: 我慢慢地呼吸，火在肺里
lines.en: I breathe slowly; fire in my lungs

lines.zh: 我在等一个值得的对手
lines.en: I wait for a worthy opponent
I fold my wings to my back
You've stepped into my firelight
I turn, wings still open
You carry the stink of iron
My hands are empty, for now
Stand where you are; don't go
I'm weighing whether you can fight
You've backed to the cliff
The ground here is hot
Your soles are smoking
I'm in no hurry; I like to watch
I step back, wings spreading
A fiery growl rolls from my throat
The fire in my hand dims
A seam splits open in my hide
I beat my wings and blow the ash away
I shape another sickle
I don't cry out
I stare at you and the fire brightens

lines.zh: 我的蹄子不耐烦地刨地
lines.en: My hoof scrapes the ground
I draw myself up again
You're carrying fire
That smell is familiar
I've smelled this in the Nether
Raise it up before your eyes

lines.zh: 我扔出去的镰刀会回旋。
lines.en: The scythe I throw comes back around.
I want more of it
Hand me the lamp
My palm is already hot
That won't even warm my hands
Take one more step forward

lines.zh: 你撞在我身上，我纹丝不动
lines.en: You hit me and I don't shift
My wing sweeps you
You duck under my arm

lines.zh: 我的蹄子落下来，石面裂了
lines.en: My hoof comes down and the rock cracks
I crash my shoulder into you
We both hit the cliff wall
You retreat and I laugh once

lines.zh: 我的尾巴缠了一下你的脚
lines.en: My tail catches your ankle
My wing brushes you and you shiver.
I left you a way past
Another waits in the red haze
Its wings are wider than mine
We exchange a look

lines.zh: 我们一起振翅，火飞了一圈
lines.en: We beat our wings and fire circles us
Its horns are cracked too

lines.zh: 我们并排站着，谁也没动
lines.en: We stand side by side, neither moving
It tilts its head toward me
We divide this ground between us
We two need no talk
Two of us in this red haze

lines.zh: 我俯身把它从火堆边捡起
lines.en: I stoop and lift it from by the fire
It burns my hand once
I crush it into a lump
This thing tastes of iron
I throw it into the fire
It melts in the flame
I tuck it under my wing
A little trade fodder for my scythe.
It reminds me of the Nether
You'd best not ask
You've raised a weapon
My palm lights up
I've shaped my sickle

lines.zh: 你身上的铁挡不住这个
lines.en: Your iron won't stop this
I rise into the air a little
I bear down out of the air
I've read your movement
Stone won't stop it here
My firelight has you pinned
You retreat fast; good
Now this has some interest
I'll give you the first move
My sickle can fly
Dodge once and you'll understand
The second won't be as easy
Scythe raised — here we begin.
I hurl the sickle
It curves in the air
You leap clear; the sickle returns
I take flight and change position

lines.zh: 你抬头找我，我在你后面
lines.en: You look up; I'm behind you
Fire burns on the ground
My wings fan the fire higher
My demon scythe spins after you.
My sickle grows more accurate
You're counting how many I have

lines.zh: 我笑了，火跟着亮了一下
lines.en: I laugh and the fire flares
This whole stretch is under my eye
Your back is to the cliff
It comes from any side
I settle back to the ground
I've closed two steps
My sickle flies sideways
It bites into your armor
I kick your knee with a hoof

lines.zh: 你退了，低头看那道口子
lines.en: You pull back and look at the cut
I lower my head and drive my horns in
My hand clamps your wrist

lines.zh: 这一下打空了，镰刀飞回来
lines.en: I miss and the sickle returns
I pounce from above
My tail lashes your back
You hold it, but your hand trembles

lines.zh: 火焰顺着我的手臂过去
lines.en: Fire runs along my arm
I shove you into the cliff
You cut me and I don't retreat

lines.zh: 烈焰粉还沾在我指缝里。
lines.en: Blaze powder still clings between my fingers.
Two points of fire light in the red haze
I drop from the cliff face

lines.zh: 下界荒地，一蹄踏出火星。
lines.en: On the Nether wastes, one hoof strikes sparks.

lines.zh: 翅膀张开，影子盖住一片地
lines.en: My wings open and my shadow covers the ground
Fire slowly takes shape in my hand

lines.zh: 下界的气息跟着我一起过来
lines.en: The Nether's breath comes with me
I straighten, far taller than you

lines.zh: 地面被我踩出两个浅坑
lines.en: Two shallow pits mark my landing
I drop my head, both horns forward

lines.zh: 你先看见的是我的眼睛
lines.en: My eyes are what you see first
I hear something living here

lines.zh: 绯红森林的风把我送来。
lines.en: The crimson forest wind carried me here.

lines.zh: 火粘在我身上，我笑了一下
lines.en: Fire clings to me and I smile

lines.zh: 我从高处落下来，翅膀没撑住
lines.en: I fall from height and my wings fail
Water; I hate the stuff

lines.zh: 爆风把我推开，我又站稳
lines.en: The blast pushes me back and I recover
An arrow sinks into my shoulder

lines.zh: 那股力量咬住我的翅膀
lines.en: That force bites into my wings
There's nothing to eat here

lines.zh: 雷打在我角上，浑身一麻
lines.en: Lightning hits my horns and I go numb

lines.zh: 下面没有地，我张开翅膀
lines.en: No ground below; I spread my wings
